commit.message:
8396626: [macos27] java/awt/dnd/MissingEventsOnModalDialog/MissingEventsOnModalDialogTest.java test fails

The reason test fails is that the drop animation now takes place for a little longer and a test
assumes that after the click is performed by the robot the component should receive it immediately so it
performs the click and then checks for the event delivery status and fails if event is not received.
The fix is to get rid of this simple logic and to use the CountDownLatch to track the event delivery
status and to add a 5 seconds wait on it before closing the gframe and deeming test as failed
